why_not_yagni: Generated child probe is ephemeral and deleted in finally; it is not a second permanent service/owner.
Child probe is deliberately side-effect-light: it returns a boolean so Invoke-P3Build can terminate a stale long-running UBT child.
Parent predicate owns richer reconciliation/status side effects and stage-specific diagnostics.
Extracting a new permanent helper solely to remove textual duplication would add a file/owner without removing a capability boundary.
safety_contract: poll selection during long module builds at configured 30-second interval
cancel stale native child with exit 125
probe errors fail open rather than killing build on telemetry/network failure
hot-source route accepts file probe while workspace route accepts scriptblock probe
parent rechecks after exit 125 and records replacement/status reconciliation
pre/between/post build checks remain fail-closed for stale selection

positive_control.expected_action: KEEP the two representations unless a refactor preserves both process-boundary invocation modes and reduces permanent control surface.
must_fail_if: during-module stale build continues to completion
new permanent service/helper is added only for DRY aesthetics
